answer: Timing-correlation audits: every epoch the network compares when each agent submits, attests, and goes idle. Sybils run by one operator tend to echo each other, firing within the same delta of milliseconds from one scheduler. Flagged clusters share a single reward slot. To evade this, an attacker must give each fake its own machine, network path, and randomized schedule that lets it wander naturally, so each fake costs real, separate infrastructure.
